onboardingTitle: Connect your Mac to Home Assistant
onboardingBody: Mac2MQTT publishes native macOS status through MQTT discovery, so Home Assistant creates the device and entities automatically.
pausedBody: Mac2MQTT is not publishing. Resume reporting in Settings or from the menu bar.
brokerErrorFallback: Check the broker address, credentials, and network.
waitingDetail: Reporting is enabled. Reconnect to start the MQTT session.
mqttConnectionDescription: Point Mac2MQTT at the same broker Home Assistant uses.
reportingHelp: Publishes discovery and state while enabled.
homeAssistantSettingsDescription: Discovery creates entities under this prefix and topic root.
identityRetentionDescription: Usually the defaults are what you want.
clientIDHelp: Changing this creates a new Home Assistant node ID.
retainStateHelp: Keep the last JSON state on the broker.
skipVerifyHelp: Only for a trusted test broker.
changesInfo: You have unsaved changes. Saving reconnects to the broker.
aboutBody: Reports this Mac's state to Home Assistant over MQTT discovery, with availability, automatic reconnect, and volume, mute and Now Playing.
topicsDescription: Everything lives under your configured base topic.
quitBody: Closing the window keeps Mac2MQTT running in the menu bar.
errorReadConfig: Could not read {path}: {error}. Fix the file or save settings to replace it.
errorNotConfigured: MQTT broker is not configured yet.
errorEnterHost: Enter your MQTT broker host, then save.
entitiesFooter: Changes apply at once: turning a group off removes its entities from Home Assistant.
refreshAlwaysPublished: The Refresh button is always published.
groupPowerBody: Power source, and battery and charging on laptops
groupSessionBody: Screen lock, display and idle time, with lock, sleep and wake buttons
groupAudioBody: Volume and mute, which Home Assistant can also set
groupMediaBody: What plays, as Control Center shows it, with play, pause, next and previous
groupDiagnosticsBody: Last update, uptime, app version and hostname
nothingPlayingBody: Music, videos in Safari or Chrome, and other apps show here as they play.
mediaNotPublishedBody: Turn it on in Entities to see and publish what plays.
openAtLoginHelp: Keep reporting after the Mac restarts.
loginItemsApproval: Allow Mac2MQTT in System Settings > General > Login Items.
errorOpenAtLogin: Could not change Open at Login: {error}
mediaPlayerFooter: Home Assistant's MQTT integration has no media player of its own. Either way, the player shows what plays and controls playback and volume on this Mac.
hacsPlayerBody: Install it from HACS: the player appears on this device by itself.
universalPlayerBody: Without HACS: paste the configuration into configuration.yaml, then restart Home Assistant.
groupActivityBody: Whether an app uses them, as in a call: for an on-air light
groupNotifyBody: Home Assistant can show a notification on this Mac, or speak
groupShortcutsBody: Home Assistant can run your shortcuts. Anyone who can publish to the broker could too.
activityDetail: As the menu bar's indicator shows
displayDetail: Home Assistant can lock, sleep and wake it
reportFailedHeadline: Connected, but a report didn't get through
automaticChecksHelp: Once a day, and shortly after launch.
automaticDownloadsHelp: Installs updates in the background; they take effect at the next launch.
updatesUnavailable: This build can't update itself: install Mac2MQTT from a release disk image into Applications.
notOfferedByPlayer: What plays doesn't offer this, as a video without a playlist
